title: A Split Session
summary: A fictional trading session shows how a flat index can hide a sharp split between sectors.

scenes.label: Market recap
scenes.headline: A flat finish hides a swing
scenes.detail: Illustrative broad index, rebased to 100 at the open
scenes.narration: In this simulated session, the broad index starts at one hundred, swings in both directions, and closes where it opened.

scenes.label: Sector moves
scenes.headline: Two sectors, opposite directions
scenes.detail: Illustrative moves from open to close
scenes.narration: Technology ends the session up two percent while energy falls two percent. The headline index hides that divergence.

scenes.label: Market breadth
scenes.headline: How many stocks rose?
scenes.narration: Forty stocks rise and sixty fall. Counting winners and losers adds a view of how broadly the market moved.
